description: Target design, critiqued then approved. Produced by solution-design, one per delta, paired with an extensibility-record by the same Row ID.

decision_log_row_id.description: The exact Row ID from the fit-to-standard decision log this design originates from, cited verbatim.

delta_summary.description: One-line restatement of the requirement from the decision log — a pointer, not a re-negotiation.

where_it_lives.description: System/component — informed by, not a substitute for, the extensibility-record's tier decision.

test_approach.description: What 'correct' looks like for this design — what backlog-drafting turns into acceptance criteria.

open_questions.description: Anything unresolved. Must be explicitly stated even if 'none' — an empty field is a claim nothing is unresolved.

source_synthesis.description: Only present when this design was assembled via compose/maintain mode (source-synthesis.md) rather than a single fit-to-standard decision-log row.

author.description: Person, or a named body/role when no individual is attributable (e.g. 'Architecture Board', 'Steering Committee') — not every real source has one signer.

fields.description: Every target_design/test_approach/etc. sub-field this conflict affects — usually one, but a scope-level conflict (e.g. rollout timing) can span several at once. Don't duplicate one conflict object per field; list them all here.

signed_spec_supersession_risk.description: True when a later informal/governance source contradicts a signed spec — per source-synthesis.md, this needs a scope amendment/CR, not a silent supersession.

uncovered_fields.description: design-record fields no source in the pack addressed at all (distinct from a field with a stated TBC/conflict) — the raw material for those TBC marks, surfaced structurally rather than falling through silently.
